fields.description: The dataset type extracted by the agent based on the query, e.g., methane, population, nitrogen dioxide.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Human-readable location or place extracted by the agent based on the query.

fields.name: bbox
fields.description: A GeoJSON string representing the bounding box coordinates of the location.

fields.name: frequency
fields.description: The periodicity or frequency of the dataset requested (e.g., daily, monthly, yearly, all).

fields.name: temporal_extent
fields.description: Time interval (start and end dates) extracted from the query.

start.description: Start date (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY).

end.description: End date (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY).
